description: Low-level time input with separate numeric fields for hours, minutes, and optional seconds. An out-of-range value stays on screen and is announced invalid instead of being silently discarded. HourCycle Auto follows the culture (12-hour with AM/PM on en-US). Used internally by TmTimePicker, TmTimeRangePicker and TmDateTimePicker.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The bound time of day. Null renders midnight in the segments until the user types.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user commits a time, including a value outside MinTime/MaxTime. The typed value is never silently discarded.

parameters.name: ValueExpression
parameters.description: Expression identifying the bound model field. Blazor supplies it automatically with @bind-Value; it links the input to EditContext.NotifyFieldChanged.

parameters.name: ShowSeconds
parameters.description: When true, a seconds segment is rendered after minutes. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables every segment and the period switch. Distinct from ReadOnly.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders every segment readonly: the time stays visible and focusable but cannot be edited. Never assigned inside the component. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: MinTime
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound. A typed value below this bound is kept on screen and announced as invalid — it is never silently discarded.

parameters.name: MaxTime
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound. A typed value above this bound is kept on screen and announced as invalid — it is never silently discarded.

parameters.name: InputId
parameters.description: Optional id applied to the hours segment so a parent label for can target it.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Optional id used as the prefix of the error element ({Id}-error). When omitted a per-instance id is generated.

parameters.name: Invalid
parameters.description: Marks every segment aria-invalid="true" — used by the owning picker when the value is out of range. Combined with the input's own min/max check so a typed out-of-range value is announced even when the host has not yet echoed it.

parameters.name: ErrorText
parameters.description: Error message rendered below the segments while invalid. Host text wins over the localized min/max message. Null or empty with Invalid true is the supported way to surface a message owned by a surrounding TmFormField.

parameters.name: AriaDescribedBy
parameters.description: Extra ids referenced from every segment's aria-describedby. Joined with the input's own error id and the surrounding TmFormField cascade.

parameters.name: HourCycle
parameters.description: 12-hour versus 24-hour clock. Default Auto follows Culture (or CurrentCulture) via ShortTimePattern — en-US is 12-hour with an AM/PM switch, cs/sk/fr/en-GB stay 24-hour. Pass H23 to force 24-hour.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve HourCycle.Auto and to format the min/max error. Null uses CurrentCulture.
